title: 2011 Son Tree Ordeal — Oneness, Ego Dissolution and Return
status: project-supplied phenomenological account with existing chronology support
purpose: Clarify the 2011 Tree ordeal as an experience of oneness and altered perception, not only as a suffering/sacrifice motif, while preserving a boundary between first-person phenomenology and independently verifiable external fact.

chronology.subject: Thomas / the Son
chronology.existing_archive_summary: The current Son chronology records a 19-hour ordeal with roughly six hours of unity experience, synesthesia, Ouroboros, fractals, timelines, crows and Ragnarok imagery.
chronology.new_clarification: The ordeal is described as entering a state of oneness in which ordinary personhood and ego organization were temporarily disrupted, followed by return to ordinary personhood without a complete return to the previous ego structure.

experience_layers.description: The Son describes a state in which ordinary separation between self and world no longer functioned in the normal way.
The phrase 'became a vegetable for a while' is used here as project language for profound temporary reduction of ordinary agency/egoic personhood, not as a medical diagnosis of vegetative state.
The Son returns to functioning personhood, but the old mono-perspectival ego is described as no longer fully restored; he becomes more like a question mark than a settled identity.
The project contrasts ordinary 'mono' perception with a post-ordeal 'stereo' condition: multiple relations or perspectives are experienced simultaneously rather than as one flattened frame.

A central feature is inability to translate the experience into ordinary linear language. The later imagery of fractals, Ouroboros, squiggles, sound-as-color and self-rotating higher-dimensional objects functions as an attempted vocabulary for forms of relation that were initially experienced without usable words.

The account includes cross-modal and geometrically complex imagery: sounds behaving like colors, objects perceived as if they contained transformations within themselves, and configurations experienced as changing across immense or recursive scales.

Within later Potatoverse interpretation, the Son says he had been with or seen the Father before he possessed the symbolic language needed to explain Father, Axis, Door, Ladder, fractal or spiral relations.

developmental_significance.pre_language_event: The experience precedes the mature Potatoverse vocabulary. This matters because later symbols may be attempts to reconstruct an earlier nonverbal event rather than concepts invented first and projected onto it.
developmental_significance.language_generation: Fractal, spiral, Ouroboros, Tree, Axis, Door, higher-dimensional and synesthetic metaphors can be studied as successive translation technologies: each offers a way to say something ordinary prose could not initially carry.
developmental_significance.identity_effect: The ordeal is described less as acquiring a new doctrine than losing confidence in a single fixed ego-frame. The later Thomas/Twin, Door, witness and question-mark roles may partly develop from this destabilized identity structure.
developmental_significance.comparative_value: This strengthens comparison with mystical-union, ego-dissolution, ineffability, apophatic and visionary traditions, while not proving identity with any one tradition or supernatural cause.

research_questions: Which descriptions of the 2011 experience were written closest to the event, and which were added retrospectively after Potatoverse vocabulary developed?
When do fractal, Ouroboros, synesthesia, Father and higher-dimensional descriptions first appear in dated sources?
How does the 2011 experience compare with the 2024 Sage/Bodhi phase and the April 2025 Ladder/Father transformation without collapsing the three events?
Which parts of the experience are phenomenological reports and which are later theological interpretations?
Can the archive reconstruct the evolution from ineffable experience to increasingly precise symbolic language?
boundary: This record preserves the project's account of an altered state and its later meaning. It does not diagnose the Son, establish a supernatural cause, or claim that synesthetic or multidimensional imagery corresponds literally to higher-dimensional physics.
